_why: Incidents from before our checks began, told from our own record so the history is honest. Each one names its source. Nothing here draws a day on the uptime bars: those start the day monitoring began.

incidents.title: Unl stopped answering connected AIs
incidents.source: our incident record: refusals began 15:41 UTC and were reversed by about 19:45 UTC; the fix that blocks the cause went live at 19:53 UTC

updates.text: A change to who may use Unl was made by mistake. From this point, requests from connected AIs were refused.
We found the cause and reversed it. Requests are being answered again.
Fixed. A change that blocks the way this mistake was made is live.
